summary.summary: This table outlines the delivery and inspection schedule under Contract No. 045-2026-ELN. It is organized into rows representing individual supply items grouped by Lot and Destination warehouse. The columns are Lot, Destination warehouse, Item, Description, Qty, Delivery date, Inspection witness, and Remarks. The groups comprise Lot 1, Lot 2, and Lot 3, delivered to Callao Central Warehouse, Av. Argentina 2850; Arequipa Regional Warehouse, Parque Industrial Mz. F; and Trujillo Regional Warehouse, Av. Nicolás de Piérola 1210. For each item, the table specifies the quantity, delivery date, inspection witness, and additional remarks.
